integrity: Proof and standalone symbolic/independent matrix-exponential checks supplied; finite checks do not replace universal analytic arguments.
scientific_limitations: Stationary symmetric Markov switching with known observation time and strictly positive diffusivities only; exact population cumulants, not finite-data inference; priority risk from general forward-moment formulas and potentially unlocated inverse formulations.
title: Single-time cumulant tomography of a symmetric two-state fluctuating diffusivity
